Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-May 2025

Body.Content:
In mid-May 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

 

  • The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code introduces Schema Designer—an intuitive, visual interface to create, edit, and manage database tables, relationships, and constraints.

Learn more
